title: Immutable work request, separate from a V3 scientific record

brief.description: Bounded work instruction, including requested comparison direction or output purpose; not authority to bypass policy.

target_refs.description: Exact task targets, each present in input_refs. Initial planning may have no business target yet.

input_artifacts.description: Explicit byte inputs, useful for source-blind formal code reading; no locator grants arbitrary filesystem access.

expected_record_types.description: Required business output families for DELIVERED; scientific acceptance is a separate gate.

exclusions.description: Principal IDs excluded by the trusted scheduler; declared strings alone cannot establish independence.

capabilities.description: Requested subset of operation capabilities; still subject to runtime authorization.
